name: 叮咚买菜
text:
#!name=叮咚买菜
#!author=queitstart pro
#!date=2026-11-21
#!format=sgmodule

[URL Rewrite]
request if ${url} ~= /^https?:\/\/maicai\.api\.ddxq\.mobi\/advert\//i then reject(404)
request if ${url} ~= /^https?:\/\/maicai\.api\.ddxq\.mobi\/homeApi\/getHomeAdPop/i then reject(404)
request if ${url} ~= /^https?:\/\/maicai\.api\.ddxq\.mobi\/vip\/getVipAd/i then reject_dict(200)
response if ${url} ~= /^https?:\/\/maicai\.api\.ddxq\.mobi\/homeApi\/newDetails/i then response.body.replace(/suspension/, "fmz200")
request if ${url} ~= /^https?:\/\/gw\.api\.ddxq\.mobi\/vip-app-service\/vip\/my\/page\/advertising/i then reject(404)
request if ${url} ~= /^https:\/\/maicai\.api\.ddxq\.mobi\/homeApi\/queryMyPagePopup/i then reject_dict(200)
request if ${url} ~= /^https?:\/\/maicai\.api\.ddxq\.mobi\/homeApi\/userLike/i then reject_dict(200)
request if ${url} ~= /^https?:\/\/maicai\.api\.ddxq\.mobi\/cart\/vipGuide/i then reject_dict(200)
request if ${url} ~= /^https?:\/\/maicai\.api\.ddxq\.mobi\/order\/getRecommend/i then reject_dict(200)

[Rule]
DOMAIN, trackercollect.ddxq.mobi,REJECT
DOMAIN, ddfs-public.ddimg.mobi,REJECT
DOMAIN, rttrack.ddxq.mobi,REJECT

[MITM]
hostname = %APPEND% maicai.api.ddxq.mobi, gw.api.ddxq.mobi, user.api.ddxq.mobi
